tools.name: esim_find_plans
tools.description: Find NUM data eSIM plans for a country, city, airport code or region, with one recommended plan for the trip. Read only. Prices are in US dollars. Plans are data only, with no phone number.

tools.name: esim_start_checkout
tools.description: Start an order for a plan from esim_find_plans and get a checkout link for the person. Nothing is charged here. The person must open the link, confirm their phone number in NUM, and pay on Stripe themselves. Ask the person before calling this.

tools.name: esim_order_status
tools.description: Check an order started with esim_start_checkout: waiting for verification, waiting for payment, paid, or ready in NUM. Never returns an install code.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "esim_start_checkout" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
